newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares ease on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares ease on profit-taking.

text.p: Slovenian shares fell on Monday as domestic investors continued to take profits out of a recent bull run, but market participans said downside was limited.
"Currently the feeling on the market is a little nervous, but I think shares have fallen enough and a rebound could come very soon," one broker said.
* The SBI index fell 18.72 points to 1,249.9.
* Bank SKB was the most actively traded, falling 1.69 percent to close at 40,020 tolars on volume of 1,450 shares.
* Overall 13 shares fell, five rose and one was unchanged while five were untraded. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
